name: io.github.cunicopia-dev/multi-account-gmail-mcp
title: Multi-Account Gmail
description: Multi-account Gmail MCP server — read, search, draft, and label across every inbox. Hardened fork: readonly mode, bulk cap, filters off by default.

environmentVariables.name: GMAIL_MCP_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Google OAuth "Desktop app" client-secret JSON. Defaults to ~/.gmail-mcp/client_secret.json.

environmentVariables.name: GMAIL_MCP_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite token store holding per-account refresh tokens. Defaults to ~/.gmail-mcp/tokens.db.

environmentVariables.name: GMAIL_MCP_OAUTH_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Localhost port for the OAuth redirect during account authorization. Defaults to 8765.

environmentVariables.name: GMAIL_MCP_ATTACHMENT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Download root for download_attachments. Files land in a per-message subdirectory. This is the only location the server writes to. Defaults to ~/.gmail-mcp/attachments.

environmentVariables.name: GMAIL_MCP_MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Per-attachment size ceiling in bytes. Defaults to 26214400 (25 MB), which is Gmail's own limit. 0 or negative means unlimited.

environmentVariables.name: GMAIL_MCP_MAX_BODY_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Default cap on returned message body length. Defaults to 500. Pass max_body_chars=0 on a call for the full body.

environmentVariables.name: GMAIL_MCP_MODE
environmentVariables.description: full (default) or readonly. Readonly does not offer write tools. gmail-mcp-auth add then requests only gmail.readonly and stores tokens in tokens-readonly.db unless GMAIL_MCP_DB is set.

environmentVariables.name: GMAIL_MCP_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist of tool names. Can only narrow what the mode already allows. Unset means no allowlist.

environmentVariables.name: GMAIL_MCP_MAX_BULK
environmentVariables.description: Refuse search-based trash, bulk_action, and modify_labels above this many matches. Default 100. 0 refuses every search mutation. Negative disables the cap.

environmentVariables.name: GMAIL_MCP_ENABLE_FILTERS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to offer create_filter and delete_filter. Off by default. list_filters does not need this.
